headline: Approved the 2026-2027 liquor license renewal for Always Full Asian Market LLC at 179 Bank Street.
summary: Members voted unanimously to adopt the consent agenda. That agenda included renewal of a second class store liquor license for 179 Bank Street, with all standard conditions.
decisions: Approved the 2026-2027 second class liquor license renewal for Always Full Asian Market LLC, 179 Bank Street, with all standard conditions, by unanimous vote on the consent agenda.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Commissioner Grant, seconded by Commissioner Schachter, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
